[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- [TC-APP-001-metadata.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0085/packages/create-app/template/.ai/qa/tests/TC-APP-001-metadata.spec.ts:5) does not actually prove `resolveLocalizedAppMetadata()` is wired correctly. The assertions on `/` match the hard-coded root layout metadata in [layout.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0085/packages/create-app/template/src/app/layout.tsx:21), so the test would still pass even if [page.tsx](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0085/packages/create-app/template/src/app/page.tsx:23) stopped calling `resolveLocalizedAppMetadata()` or `src/lib/metadata.ts` regressed.
- [TC-APP-001-metadata.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0085/packages/create-app/template/.ai/qa/tests/TC-APP-001-metadata.spec.ts:15) does not distinguish the translated `titleKey` branch from the plain fallback branch in `resolveLocalizedTitleMetadata()`. `/backend/example` is asserted as `'Example Admin'`, but that value is both the route fallback in [page.meta.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0085/packages/create-app/template/src/modules/example/backend/page.meta.ts:13) and the English translation, so skipping `titleKey` lookup would still pass. The homepage description regex has the same problem: it accepts both translated and fallback text. As written, the new spec does not meaningfully verify the localized path it claims to cover.

No scoped Playwright or standalone create-app validation artifacts were present in this worktree, so this review is based on the branch diff and the touched-area behavior.
